ListProjects.description: List projects in trusted discovery scopes without starting a session. searchScope.scopes reports successfully searched ranges; empty results mean no matches only there. Discovery does not grant read or control access.

ListSessions.description: List App sessions across projects by case-insensitive title substring, not full-text message search. Search unarchived sessions first: omit archived or use archived:"exclude". searchScope.scopes reports searched ranges; empty scopes means no range was successfully searched. Does not resume or navigate.

project.description: A project from ListProjects, replayed exactly as that result returned it.

cursor.description: The nextCursor from the previous page of this same call. Omit it for the first page.

ReadSession.description: Read a session summary or bounded history without execution, navigation or marking it read.

CreateSession.description: Create a root session in an existing project and submit its first prompt. Creation and input admission are reported separately. Does not steal focus.

WaitSessions.description: Wait for the exact create/send operations, using any or all. timeoutMs=0 queries now. Cancelling this wait does not stop target execution. Never wait for your own future completion.

sessionId.description: The id of the session that returned this operation, as given in its result.

commandId.description: Replay the whole `operation` object from the create or send result; do not rebuild it.

InterruptSession.description: Interrupt only expectedExecutionId. A changed execution is rejected; session history is retained.

expectedExecutionId.description: The executionId reported by ListSessions or WaitSessions for this session. If neither reports one the session is not executing, so there is nothing to interrupt.
